title_zh: 为争执中的侮辱道歉并商定暂停信号

scenario.label_zh: 为争执中的侮辱道歉并商定暂停信号
scenario.goal_zh: 承认争吵中的言语伤害并道歉并约定使用暂停信号而不是继续喊叫

context_zh: 两位成年室友在一次口角后谈论彼此的沟通方式；场景为虚构，无针对真实人物的指控。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: I'm sorry about the vicious things I said last night. Being annoyed doesn't excuse them.

sentences.speaker: Lara
sentences.text: Thank you for saying that. I can discuss a disagreement, but I won't tolerate being insulted.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: I understand. I was wrong to make it personal.

sentences.speaker: Lara
sentences.text: If either of us starts to yell, can we say 'pause' and stop the conversation for a while?

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Yes. Either person can call it, and we can come back when we're ready to speak calmly.

sentences.speaker: Lara
sentences.text: That's a better plan than trying to win the argument.
